title: Dendera light bulb relief

tellings.quote: That we I mean, you go down to like the Dendara temples in Egypt where you've got the light bulb, you know, the the kind of the classic light bulb.

plain: A carving at the temple of Dendera in Egypt is said to show a light bulb, what one guest calls "the classic light bulb." Jay Anderson, a guest who says he has seen it himself, raises it with Michels as a sign that the ancient Egyptians may have known more than we credit them with.
